owner_titles: Chairman of the Board and CEO
footnote_text: On November 13, 2026, 20,386,630 Class Z ordinary shares repurchased by the issuer were cancelled, and Mr. Rui Chen, as a WVR beneficiary, converted a total of 2,562,193 Class Y ordinary shares held by Vanship Limited, a company controlled by Mr. Rui Chen, to Class Z ordinary shares on a one-to-one ratio as required by the Hong Kong Listing Rules.
